caption: A roller of white paint is run over a patch of wet red paint on a wall, and it leaves a pink streak where they blend.

sa.check: A patch of red paint is on a wall.
A roller of white paint is run over it.
It leaves a pink streak where they blend.
The roller passes first and the pink streak follows.

pc.expect: Pink appears only along the roller's path through the red and does not turn white again.
pc.fail: Pink appears where the roller has not passed; or the streak turns white; or the pink retreats.

pc.expect: The blend is pink, and the untouched red stays red.
pc.fail: The blend is a colour other than pink; or the untouched red changes; or the white paint stays white over the red.

pc.expect: Wet paint smears and blends under the roller.
pc.fail: The paints stay as separate hard layers; or the paint flows like water; or the roller passes without marking.

pc.expect: Paint moves only where the roller pushes it.
pc.fail: Paint runs by itself; or the roller moves by itself; or the wall changes.
A second roller appears; or the wall vanishes; or paint appears from nowhere.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The wall and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The wall changes shape; or the room rearranges; or the roller changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
